title: A characterization of the ellipsoid in terms of pairs of sections associated by a harmonic homology
summary: Let $K$ be a convex body in an affine chart of the $n$ dimensional real Projective space $\mathbb{RP}^n$, $n \geq 3$, let $H$ be a hyperplane which is not a support hyperplane of $K$ and let $p_1,p_2 \in \mathbb{RP}^n \setminus H$ be two distinct interior points of $K$. In this work we prove that if for every $(n-2)$-plane $l \subset H$, there exists a harmonic homology, with plane $G$ and center $τ$, such that $l\subset G$, $τ\in H$ and which maps the hypersection of $K$ defined by aff$\{p_1, l\}$ onto the hypersection of $K$ defined by aff$\{p_2, l\}$, then $K$ is an ellipsoid.
